Few things to be noted here for each reasons.

#1. You can migrate your insurance with same provider without any issues. Its IRDA mandate. And later if you want to port to a different company you can also do that. Both ways, waiting period will be waived off. All your history should get transferred.

#3 - You can increase premium every year to compensate inflation

#5 - Is applicable only if you are on old tax scheme
comments.author: @the_travelling_pixel

comments.text:
1) Corporate policies are trailer made policies, if your employer already chooses the portability option then you can port your plan.
Example - If you switch from one company to another company and new employer are not providing the insurance cover to you in such case before leaving the old company you have to opt for Portability, under portability benefits waiting period will be waived off and all pre-existing disease will cover from day.
Condition- at least 4 years you have served in the organisation.
2 Under corporate plans, it depends on your corporate if they are open for multiple sum insured options then you can choose accordingly.
3. Yes.
